reviewMethod: Primary-document extraction and cross-check by a coding assistant; not human certification.
currentBlocker: Current rates are not verified. TNERC Order 6/2025, page 34, requires an inflation-based revision from 1 July 2026. The official indexes checked do not establish that revision and the corresponding consumer subsidy. Pre-July rates must not be assumed current.
rounding: Energy illustration only: sum exact hundredth-kWh products, then round half-up once to the nearest paise. This is not an assertion about TNPDCL meter or final bill rounding.
